neighbours.label: the second conjunct of a coordinated pair of modifiers sharing one head noun (first and *second* instars, North and *Baltic* seas)
fire: The spray kills both first and second instars of the beetle.
Ships crossed the North and Baltic seas every summer.
The rule applies to primary and secondary schools alike.
Damage was found on the leading and trailing edges of the wing.
The study covered upper and lower limbs of each patient.
Both the inner and outer walls were painted white.
Prices rose in eastern and western regions of the country.
We tested the front and rear brakes of every bicycle.
quiet: The spray kills the young larvae of the beetle in spring.
Ships crossed the cold northern seas every summer.
The rule applies to every school in the district alike.
Damage was found along the edge of the left wing.
The study covered the limbs of each patient carefully.
Both of the old walls were painted white.
Prices rose in many regions of the country.
We tested the brakes of every bicycle in the shop.

notes: Card: peaks on ' second', ' third', ' leading', ' and' inside coordinated modifier pairs.
